description: One primary user outcome per packaged Axis skill. Handoffs are one-way execution dependencies, not trigger aliases. / 每个 Axis 技能只对应一个主要用户结果；handoff 是单向执行依赖，不是重复触发入口。

skills.name: axis-code-api-performance-tuning
skills.primary_outcome: Optimize measured API read latency without changing business semantics
skills.use_when: Use after a slow read path is identified and code or query optimization is requested. / 用于已定位慢读链路并要求优化代码或查询时。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use for measurement-only capacity work or generic defect repair. / 不用于只测容量或通用缺陷修复。

skills.name: axis-code-arch-optimize
skills.primary_outcome: Promote repeated local fixes into one shared architecture capability
skills.use_when: Use when several local implementations reveal one reusable cross-cutting boundary. / 用于多处局部实现暴露出同一可复用横切边界时。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use for a one-method defect with no demonstrated reuse boundary. / 不用于尚无复用证据的单方法缺陷。

skills.name: axis-code-bugfix
skills.primary_outcome: Find and repair the root cause of an observed software failure
skills.use_when: Use for reported bugs, errors, regressions, flaky behavior, or failing evidence. / 用于已报告缺陷、报错、回归、偶发行为或失败证据。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use for a behavior change with no failure to diagnose or for capacity measurement. / 不用于无故障待诊断的行为变更或容量测量。

skills.name: axis-code-capture
skills.primary_outcome: Package completed code-change evidence as an Axis execution record
skills.use_when: Use after coding work needs an execution report and reusable experience card. / 用于编码工作完成后生成执行报告与经验卡片。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use to implement or diagnose the code change itself. / 不用于实现或诊断代码变更本身。

skills.name: axis-doc-contract-review
skills.primary_outcome: Review one contract and deliver separate annotated and publication-clean DOCX files
skills.use_when: Use for comment-by-comment contract or agreement review with current legal grounds and verified DOCX outputs. / 用于逐条评审合同或协议，并依据现行法律交付经验证的批注回应版与发布清洁版。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use for software design documents, legal representation, or guaranteed compliance conclusions. / 不用于软件设计文档、法律代理或保证合规的结论。

skills.name: axis-doc-dashboard
skills.primary_outcome: Start and open the correct local Axis document dashboard
skills.use_when: Use when the user wants to view the local Axis document catalog or history. / 用于用户要查看本地 Axis 文档目录或历史。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use to generate, reconcile, or publish documents. / 不用于生成、梳理或发布文档。

skills.name: axis-doc-development
skills.primary_outcome: Create or revise one feature's development design documents
skills.use_when: Use for feature discovery, master-draft expansion, detailed design, correction, or iteration. / 用于功能问询、原始稿扩写、详细设计、修正或迭代。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use for project-wide knowledge bootstrap or post-task audit records. / 不用于项目级知识初始化或任务后审计记录。

skills.name: axis-doc-drift-capture
skills.primary_outcome: Record completed-task document drift and version impact
skills.use_when: Use after a task or PR is complete and audit records are required. / 用于任务或 PR 完成后需要审计记录时。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use to author the feature design or silently rewrite canonical documents. / 不用于编写功能设计或静默改写正式文档。

skills.name: axis-doc-project-init
skills.primary_outcome: Inspect and apply one Axis v0.2 project configuration
skills.use_when: Use to initialize or migrate repository-level Axis organization, project, OSS, release, and local settings. / 用于初始化或迁移仓库级 Axis 组织、项目、OSS、发布与本地配置。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use to generate project knowledge or upload content. / 不用于生成项目知识或上传内容。

skills.name: axis-doc-project-knowledge
skills.primary_outcome: Build or reconcile the canonical project-wide Axis knowledge set
skills.use_when: Use for global architecture, capability inventory, secondary designs, navigation, and gap reconciliation. / 用于全局架构、能力清单、二级设计、导航与缺口梳理。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use for one feature draft, dashboard startup, or unconfirmed OSS upload. / 不用于单功能草稿、看板启动或未经确认的 OSS 上传。

skills.name: axis-integration-doudian-merchandising
skills.primary_outcome: Automatically exhaust current same-category Doudian opportunities and publish every supplier-safe conservatively profitable product
skills.use_when: Use for an explicitly invoked full-auto Doudian run across 商机中心 追抖音热词/跟潜力爆品, 商品管理 发布潜力商品, and 源头好货 抖音爆款榜/热搜商机, with supplier-safe conservatively profitable automatic listings. / 用于明确调用全自动抖店任务，遍历商机中心追抖音热词/跟潜力爆品、商品管理发布潜力商品及源头好货抖音爆款榜/热搜商机，并对货源安全且保守盈利的商品自动上架时。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use implicitly, for another marketplace, for financial transactions, or for blind bulk publishing without current evidence and conservative profit validation. / 不可隐式调用，也不用于其他平台、资金操作或缺少当前证据与保守利润验证的盲目批量上架。

skills.name: axis-integration-yunxiao-codeup
skills.primary_outcome: Query a Yunxiao Codeup repository or create one explicitly requested merge request
skills.use_when: Use for bounded repository lookup or an explicitly requested merge-request creation through Codeup OpenAPI. / 用于通过 Codeup OpenAPI 执行有边界的仓库查询或明确请求的合并请求创建。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use for local Git-only work or another source-control provider. / 不用于纯本地 Git 操作或其他代码平台。

skills.name: axis-ops-ali-dashboard
skills.primary_outcome: Create or validate Alibaba Cloud dashboard JSON and drilldowns
skills.use_when: Use for CloudMonitor or SLS dashboard structure, queries, panels, and drilldowns. / 用于 CloudMonitor 或 SLS 看板结构、查询、面板与下钻。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use for general observability diagnosis without a dashboard artifact. / 不用于没有看板产物的通用可观测性排查。

skills.name: axis-ops-oss-publish
skills.primary_outcome: Validate and publish an authorized Axis outbox package to OSS
skills.use_when: Use for redaction, dry-run, document sync, or immutable upload after explicit confirmation. / 用于明确确认后的脱敏、预演、文档同步或不可变上传。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use to create source documents or infer upload consent. / 不用于创建源文档或推断上传同意。

skills.name: axis-test-benchmark
skills.primary_outcome: Measure latency, throughput, concurrency, or capacity with reproducible evidence
skills.use_when: Use when the requested result is a benchmark or capacity measurement. / 用于目标结果是基准测试或容量测量时。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use when the requested result is code optimization rather than measurement. / 不用于目标结果是代码优化而非测量时。

skills.name: axis-test-report
skills.primary_outcome: Package completed verification evidence as an Axis test report
skills.use_when: Use after build, lint, test, benchmark, or pressure-test evidence exists. / 用于已有构建、lint、测试、基准或压测证据后。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use to execute the underlying test or benchmark. / 不用于执行底层测试或压测。

skills.name: axis-test-side-effects
skills.primary_outcome: Verify a real state-changing action with explicit safety and cleanup controls
skills.use_when: Use for tests that mutate external state, publish messages, or require cleanup. / 用于会修改外部状态、投递消息或需要清理的测试。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use for pure unit tests with no real side effect. / 不用于没有真实副作用的纯单元测试。

skills.name: axis-test-tdd
skills.primary_outcome: Drive a behavior change from a failing test to verified implementation
skills.use_when: Use when the user explicitly requests TDD/RED-GREEN-REFACTOR, or when an owning code skill conditionally hands off implementation method. / 用于用户明确要求 TDD/红绿重构，或主代码技能有条件交接实现方法时。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not compete with the owning bugfix, architecture, or performance outcome; do not use for diagnosis-only work or report packaging. / 不与缺陷修复、架构或性能主结果竞争，也不用于只诊断或报告打包。

skills.name: axis-trade-daily-brief
skills.primary_outcome: Produce one source-backed daily risk brief for configured assets and plans
skills.use_when: Use for read-only daily monitoring with freshness, deduplication, risk escalation, and delivery status. / 用于只读的每日监控，包含时效、去重、风险升级与交付状态。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use to execute orders, change positions, approve plans, or mutate the trading system. / 不用于执行订单、改变持仓、批准计划或修改交易系统。

skills.name: axis-trade-plan-gate
skills.primary_outcome: Gate one investment plan against approved system, research, and portfolio evidence
skills.use_when: Use to propose, review, activate, revise, or close an investment plan under explicit evidence and approval gates. / 用于在明确证据与审批门禁下提出、评审、激活、修订或结束投资计划。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use to execute an order, alter system parameters, or fabricate missing portfolio evidence. / 不用于执行订单、修改系统参数或虚构缺失的组合证据。

skills.name: axis-trade-portfolio-ledger
skills.primary_outcome: Reconcile and post one source-aware private portfolio ledger update
skills.use_when: Use to import, reconcile, post, value, or snapshot holdings across supported asset classes. / 用于跨资产类别导入、核对、入账、估值或快照持仓。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use for watchlists, inferred holdings, order execution, or unreconciled silent writes. / 不用于关注列表、推断持仓、订单执行或未核对的静默写入。

skills.name: axis-trade-risk-research
skills.primary_outcome: Create one current source-backed asset risk eligibility snapshot
skills.use_when: Use for current fundamental, regulatory, market-structure, custody, or protocol-risk research on an exact asset identity. / 用于对精确资产身份开展当前基本面、监管、市场结构、托管或协议风险研究。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use to approve a plan, alter a trading system, or claim that an asset is risk-free. / 不用于批准计划、修改交易系统或宣称资产无风险。

skills.name: axis-trade-system-governance
skills.primary_outcome: Version and apply one explicitly approved trading-system parameter change
skills.use_when: Use to initialize, inspect, evaluate, version, or approval-gate a trading-system rule change. / 用于初始化、检查、评估、版本化或审批门禁交易系统规则变更。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use to approve an asset plan, reconcile holdings, generate a brief, or execute an order. / 不用于批准资产计划、核对持仓、生成简报或执行订单。

skills.name: axis-tools-prompt-create
skills.primary_outcome: Select a robust prompt through blind cross-source and cross-tier evaluation
skills.use_when: Use to create, refine, compare, or select a non-trivial prompt with an evaluation oracle. / 用于在有评测口径时创建、改进、比较或选择非平凡提示词。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use to package a skill or execute a frozen domain prompt. / 不用于打包技能或执行已冻结的领域提示词。

skills.name: axis-tools-skill-create
skills.primary_outcome: Create or refactor one reusable public-safe skill package
skills.use_when: Use as the single entrypoint for skill discovery, creation, review, and refactoring. / 用作技能发现、创建、审查和重构的唯一入口。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use for prompt-only R&D or local installation-only work. / 不用于只做提示词研发或只做本地安装。

skills.name: axis-tools-skill-update
skills.primary_outcome: Install or refresh packaged Axis skills with backup and parity verification
skills.use_when: Use when local Codex or Claude skill bundles must be updated from axis-tools. / 用于从 axis-tools 更新本地 Codex 或 Claude 技能包。
skills.do_not_use_when: Do not use to author or refactor skill content. / 不用于编写或重构技能内容。
